## PREPROCESS
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(gridExtra)
library(dendextend)
```


```{r}
spotify_data = read.csv("high_popularity_spotify_data.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
```

```{r}
spotify_data_clean <- spotify_data[!is.na(spotify_data$track_album_name), ]
cols_to_remove <- c("track_id", "track_href", "uri", "analysis_url", "id", 
                    "playlist_id", "type", "track_album_id", "key", "mode","time_signature")

spotify_data_clean <- spotify_data_clean[ , !(names(spotify_data_clean) %in% cols_to_remove)]

spotify_data_clean$track_popularity <- as.numeric(spotify_data_clean$track_popularity)
spotify_data_clean$duration_ms <- as.numeric(spotify_data_clean$duration_ms)
names(spotify_data_clean)
```
```{r}
sapply(spotify_data_clean, class)
```
```{r}
summary(spotify_data_clean)
```

```{r}
top_5_genres <- spotify_data_clean %>%
  count(playlist_genre, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(playlist_genre)

filtered_data <- spotify_data_clean %>%
  filter(playlist_genre %in% top_5_genres)

top_5_subgenres <- filtered_data %>%
  count(playlist_subgenre, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(playlist_subgenre)

sp_filtered <- filtered_data %>%
  filter(playlist_subgenre %in% top_5_subgenres)
```


```{r}
sp_filtered <- sp_filtered[!duplicated(sp_filtered), ]

sp_filtered$playlist_genre <- as.factor(sp_filtered$playlist_genre)
```

```{r}
View(sp_filtered)
```

```{r}
num_vars <- names(sp_filtered)[sapply(sp_filtered, is.numeric)]
num_vars <- setdiff(num_vars, c("tempo", "duration_ms", "loudness"))
print(num_vars)

```


```{r}
categorize_variable <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = c(0, 1/3, 2/3, 1), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (length(unique(q)) < 4) {
    cut(x,
        breaks = quantile(x, probs = c(0, 0.5, 1), na.rm = TRUE),
        labels = c("Bajo", "Alto"),
        include.lowest = TRUE)
  } else {
    cut(x,
        breaks = q,
        labels = c("Bajo", "Medio", "Alto"),
        include.lowest = TRUE)
  }
}

for (var in num_vars) {
  sp_filtered[[paste0(var, "_cat")]] <- categorize_variable(sp_filtered[[var]])
}
```


```{r}
View(sp_filtered)
```

```{r}
cat_vars <- c("energy_cat", "danceability_cat", "liveness_cat", "valence_cat", "speechiness_cat", "track_popularity_cat", "instrumentalness_cat", "acousticness_cat", "playlist_genre")

mca_data <- sp_filtered[, cat_vars]

mca_data[] <- lapply(mca_data, as.factor)
```

```{r}
res.mca <- MCA(mca_data, graph = FALSE)

fviz_mca_biplot(res.mca, 
                repel = TRUE, 
                ggtheme = theme_minimal())
```

```{r}
vaps = res.mca$eig
```

```{r}
mean_vaps <- mean(vaps[, 1])  
print(mean_vaps)
```
```{r}
barplot(res.mca$eig[,2],main="Eigenvalues", names.arg=1:nrow(res.mca$eig))
```

```{r}
cat_vars <- c("energy_cat", "danceability_cat", "valence_cat",
              "speechiness_cat", "instrumentalness_cat", "acousticness_cat")

plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(cat_vars)) {
  plot_list[[i]] <- fviz_mca_ind(
    res.mca,
    habillage = cat_vars[i],
    label = "none",
    addEllipses = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE,
    title = paste("MCA -", cat_vars[i])
  )
}

grid.arrange(grobs = plot_list, ncol = 3, nrow = 2)

```

```{r}
# Plot 1: Active categories only (without individuals)
plot1 <- fviz_mca_var(res.mca, 
                      choice = "mca.cor",
                      title = "Graph of the active categories",
                      repel = TRUE,
                      ggtheme = theme_minimal())

# Plot 2: Cloud of variables 
plot2 <- fviz_mca_var(res.mca,
                      title = "Cloud of variables",
                      repel = TRUE,
                      ggtheme = theme_minimal())

# Plot 3: MCA classified by playlist_genre
plot3 <- fviz_mca_ind(res.mca,
                      habillage = "playlist_genre",
                      title = "MCA classified by playlist_genre",
                      repel = TRUE,
                      ggtheme = theme_minimal(),
                      legend.title = "Playlist Genre")

combined_plot <- grid.arrange(plot1, plot2, plot3, 
                             ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                             top = "Multiple Correspondence Analysis - Combined View")

combined_plot
```


```{r}
dim_combinations <- list(c(1,2))

for (var in cat_vars) {
  for (dims in dim_combinations) {
    print(
      plot.MCA(res.mca,
               choix = "ind",
               label = "none",
               invisible = "var",
               habillage = var,
               axes = dims,
               title = paste("MCA -", var, "- Dimensiones", paste(dims, collapse = "-")))
    )
  }
}
```

ANALISIS CLUSTER

```{r}
spotify_data_cluster = read.csv("high_popularity_spotify_data.csv")
spotify_data_clean_cluster <- spotify_data_cluster[!is.na(spotify_data_cluster$track_album_name), ]
cols_to_remove <- c("track_id", "track_href", "uri", "analysis_url", "id", 
                    "playlist_id", "type", "track_album_id", "key", "mode","time_signature")

spotify_data_clean_cluster <- spotify_data_clean_cluster[ , !(names(spotify_data_clean_cluster) %in% cols_to_remove)]

spotify_data_clean_cluster$track_popularity <- as.numeric(spotify_data_clean_cluster$track_popularity)
spotify_data_clean_cluster$duration_ms <- as.numeric(spotify_data_clean_cluster$duration_ms)
```

```{r}
top_5_genres_cluster <- spotify_data_clean_cluster %>%
  count(playlist_genre, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(playlist_genre)

filtered_data_cluster <- spotify_data_clean_cluster %>%
  filter(playlist_genre %in% top_5_genres_cluster)

top_5_subgenres_cluster <- filtered_data_cluster %>%
  count(playlist_subgenre, sort = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1:5) %>%
  pull(playlist_subgenre)

sp_filtered_cluster <- filtered_data_cluster %>%
  filter(playlist_subgenre %in% top_5_subgenres_cluster)
```

```{r}
View(sp_filtered_cluster)
```


```{r}
sp_filtered_cluster <- sp_filtered_cluster[!duplicated(sp_filtered_cluster$track_name), ]

rownames(sp_filtered_cluster) <- sp_filtered_cluster$track_name

sp_numeric <- sp_filtered_cluster[sapply(sp_filtered_cluster, is.numeric)]
spoty_cluster = scale(sp_numeric)
d <- dist(spoty_cluster)
```

```{r}
spoty_cluster_df <- as.data.frame(spoty_cluster)

```

```{r}
class(spoty_cluster_df)
```


```{r}
fit_single <- hclust(d, method = "single")
plot(fit_single, main = "Dendrogram of Single Linkage")
```

```{r}
fit_complete <- hclust(d, method = "complete")
plot(fit_complete, main = "Dendrogram of Complete Linkage")
```
```{r}
fit_average <- hclust(d, method = "average")
plot(fit_average, main = "Dendrogram of Average Linkage")
```
```{r}
fit_ward <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
plot(fit_ward, main = "Dendrogram of Ward Method")
```

```{r}
fit_centroid <- hclust(d, method = "centroid")
plot(fit_centroid, main = "Dendrogram of Centroid Method")

```

```{r}
dend1 <- as.dendrogram(fit_ward)

groups <- cutree(fit_ward, k = 3)

group_colors <- c("blue", "red", "green")

labels_colors(dend1) <- group_colors[groups[order.dendrogram(dend1)]]

plot(dend1, main = "Dendrogram with Leaf Labels Colored by Cluster")
```

```{r}
set.seed(987)
aux_f <- c()
for (i in 2:9) {
  k <- kmeans(spoty_cluster_df, centers = i, nstart = 25)
  aux_f[i - 1] <- (k$betweenss * (nrow(spoty_cluster) - i)) / (k$tot.withinss * (i - 1))
}
plot(2:9, aux_f, type = "l", xlab = "Number of Clusters", ylab = "Pseudo-F", main = "Pseudo-F Index")
```
